extraction_notes: Premium plan shows "$1,000 per month / billed yearly", which is the effective annual per-month price. Essentials shows "$100 per month / billed monthly" - this is monthly billing. Enterprise is custom pricing (Talk to sales). The page includes a detailed feature comparison table; I extracted the most material limits and features for each plan. Features like "AI translator", "email content analysis", etc. were not included as they don't match the specified feature list. Custom execution skills, routine tasks, and channels for AI Agent are customizable per plan but listed as specific numbers (3/10, 1/5 weekly/daily) in the comparison table - these vary and are handled as custom/elevated tiers within plans rather than separate limits. The page mentions support packages are "available for Premium and Enterprise Plans" and includes add-ons for additional profiles and emails, but these are usage-based charges, not separate subscription plans.
